title: CASS student explores new opportunities on Global Gateway journey
summary_en: Aniya Burnett was among the first cohort of Counseling and Student Services majors to participate in Global Gateway, spending three weeks of her summer in New Zealand. She was inspired to pursue counseling and student services because of a desire to work in higher education and support students from diverse and multicultural backgrounds, especially students of color.
